form.label: 0 · Trust Scorecard
form.description: Executive view: are credentials short-lived, is every action attributed, and what did policy block? (Demo data is synthetic.)

search.query: $src$ sourcetype=teleport:audit | eval actor=coalesce(user, 'identity.user', user_name, "unknown") | eval actor_type=case(like(actor,"bot-%"),"machine", actor="system","system", like(actor,"%.localhost"),"system", true(),"human") | eval actor_class=case(actor_type="human","human", match(actor,"^bot-(claude|copilot|lab)"),"ai_agent", actor_type="machine","workload", true(),"system") | eval outcome=if(success="false" OR like(code,"%W"),"denied","allowed") | eval src=coalesce('addr.remote','identity.client_ip') | eval src_ip=replace(src,":\d+$$","") | eval resource=coalesce(db_service, app_name, server_hostname, kubernetes_cluster) | eval hour_utc=floor((_time%86400)/3600) | eval ttl_h=if(event="cert.create", round((strptime(substr('identity.expires',1,19)."+0000","%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z")-_time)/3600,2), null()) | eval is_write=if(event="db.session.query" AND match(db_query,"(?i)^\s*(create|drop|alter|insert|update|delete|truncate|grant)"),1,0) | fields _time, event, code, user, success, error, method, mfa_device, name, roles, login, sid, uid, db_service, db_name, db_user, db_query, app_name, server_hostname, kubernetes_cluster, verb, request_path, response_code, bot_name, user_name, "identity.user", "identity.roles{}", "identity.expires", "identity.client_ip", "addr.remote", demo, actor, actor_type, actor_class, outcome, src, src_ip, resource, hour_utc, ttl_h, is_write
| search event="cert.create" | stats count as certs, count(eval(ttl_h<=12)) as short | eval pct=if(certs>0, round(short/certs*100,1), 0) | fields pct
| search event="cert.create" | stats count(eval(ttl_h>24)) as long_lived
| search event="cert.create" | stats avg(ttl_h) as h | eval h=round(h,1) | fields h
| stats count as total, count(eval(actor_type="machine")) as m | eval pct=if(total>0, round(m/total*100,0), 0) | fields pct

panel.title: Credentials issued per day: people vs machines

search.query: | search event="cert.create" | timechart span=1d count by actor_type
| search event="cert.create" | stats avg(ttl_h) as avg_hours by actor_type | eval avg_hours=round(avg_hours,2)
| where outcome="denied" | timechart span=1d count by event
| where outcome="denied" | eval reason=substr(error,1,95) | stats count by actor, event, reason | sort - count

div.div:
Before (PPI Financial Services, customer story)
Manual certificate management, complex onboarding, fragmented access workflows.

After
Single sign-on, short-lived access, every session audited, access policy managed as code (Kubernetes operator + Terraform).

What this lab shows
The same idea for humans and machines and AI agents: credentials that expire in hours, each action tied to an identity, denials recorded. Source for the PPI FS points: Teleport customer story.
